title: worst experience ever!
text: worst experience ever!. I had high hope for this chair but I was so disappointed when I got it. The actual chair looks nothing like the photos posted on the site. The quality is terrible! It is so hard to assemble, and there were missing parts that I have to go to Lowes to get those parts. And the chair is very uncomfortable to use. It hurts my back so badly after using it for only twenty minutes. I tried to contact the seller but they never replied my email, and their phone number is international. My money is wasted, and I hope you don't have to!
